docs.title: Documentation
docs.intro: How work is organised in the app, from a mission to a record in History. The steps follow the same order as on Home and in the menu.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body: Everything starts with a mission: name, type (planned, emergency, post-storm), drone profile, transit altitude and weather limits. Create it on Home or from the mission menu in the header. The other screens save their data into the active mission; change its parameters with the Mission settings button.

farm.title: Wind farm from KML/KMZ
farm.body: On the Routes screen, click Import KML/KMZ or drop the file onto the map: turbines are placemarks with a point. Hub height and rotor diameter missing from the file come from Turbine defaults. You can also place turbines by clicking the map (the Add turbines by click switch), drag them, or delete one from its marker popup.

route.title: Route
route.body: Click Build route: the visiting order is chosen automatically, taking the takeoff point and the maximum turn angle into account. The takeoff point defaults to the farm centre and can be dragged. Adjust the order with the arrows in Visiting order; the summary shows plan length, flight time and battery use. The route can be exported as JSON and KML.

weather.title: Weather and departure
weather.body: On the Weather screen, pick the forecast point (the farm centre by default) and the period, then click Get forecast. The hourly Open-Meteo forecast — wind at altitude, gusts, precipitation, visibility, temperature — is saved to the mission right away. The Flight window strip colours each hour by the mission and drone limits; click an hour to make it the departure hour. All hours are in the farm's local time.

forecast.title: Flight forecast
forecast.body: The Flight forecast card on Home and on the Weather screen checks the chosen hour: go, marginal or no-go — with reasons, wind at the plan's altitudes and an estimate of length, time, battery and number of sorties. The mission status Departure set only means the data is in place: whether you can fly is decided by this verdict.

simulation.title: 3D flight
simulation.body: The 3D flight screen (the Open in 3D button on Routes) plays back the same flight plan as the map: takeoff, transits at transit altitude, the climb to hub height and the orbit of each turbine, return and landing — at real heights and at the drone cruise speed. Turbines are built from hub height and rotor diameter; with a departure hour chosen, rotors turn and face the forecast wind. Segments entering a tower safety zone are red. The panel shows the flight phase, height, distance, time, turbines inspected and battery left against the reserve, the weather at departure and the inspection order (click to jump to a turbine). Camera: follow, free (mouse) or top; keys: Space — play and pause, R — restart, [ and ] — speed, C — camera. The Map on the ground switch below the scene lays an OpenStreetMap layer on the ground. At the end of playback or from the header — Complete flight…

complete.title: Completing the flight
complete.body: After the flight, click Complete flight on Home or Complete flight… on the 3D flight screen. Weather, route, farm, limits and the drone profile become the flight record and are read-only from then on; only the name can still be changed. Nothing is deleted, and the active mission is cleared.

detection.title: Defect detection
detection.body: On the Detection screen, add the inspection photos: they are stored with the mission on this computer. A YOLO model runs inside the app without a network — on the GPU via WebGPU or on the CPU via WASM; large images are analysed in tiles. Findings have a class (crack, corrosion, erosion, lightning strike, contamination, delamination, other) and a severity from 1 to 5 that the operator reviews and adjusts; the confidence threshold and classes change without re-running the analysis. Photos with EXIF coordinates are matched to the nearest turbine of the farm (within 300 m). Exports: PNG with boxes, JSON per photo and for the whole mission; the number of findings shows in History.

history.title: History
history.body: All missions: search by name, filter by In progress, Flown and Archived, open, view the route in 3D, archive a flown mission, and delete. Each mission can be exported as JSON, and the listed missions as an HTML report. A flown mission opens on Home for viewing.
